descriptions.value: The Essential Addons for Elementor  WordPress plugin before 6.8.7 does not restrict the post type or meta query an unauthenticated visitor can pass to its pagination endpoint, which could allow them to read content of non-public post types and recover the values of private custom fields on published posts.

assertions.title: Essential Addons for Elementor < 6.8.7 - Unauthenticated Private Post Meta Disclosure via load_more AJAX Handler

descriptions.description: CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: Essential Addons for Elementor < 6.8.7 - Unauthenticated Private Post Meta Disclosure via load_more AJAX Handler

descriptions.value: The GoSMTP  WordPress plugin before 1.2.5 does not perform a settings-management authorization check on its SMTP configuration page, which is gated only on the GoSMTP  WordPress plugin before 1.2.5-activation capability, allowing users with a delegated role below administrator to change outbound mail delivery and achieve administrator account takeover.

assertions.title: GoSMTP < 1.2.5 - Plugin Activator+ Privilege Escalation via SMTP Settings

title: GoSMTP < 1.2.5 - Plugin Activator+ Privilege Escalation via SMTP Settings
